messages:
zoe (docs): heads-up i'm opening a small PR to refresh streaming + pagination snippets to use iterator patterns across py/ts/go. aim: clearer resume-token guidance, simple client-side retries, and a short migration note from callbacks. draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120
li (eng-runtime): 👍 please include a short paragraph about resume token guarantees (best-effort, not persisted across model variant) and call out KV cache partial-prefix behaviour on reconnects.
matt (eng-ml): add a note about model quantization swaps — we saw token duplication in one customer flow. small compatibility blurb should be fine.
zoe (docs): plan: three tiny examples (py async-iterator + backoff, ts for-await-of + AbortController, go channel + context timeout). also add a migration table mapping callbacks -> iterator idioms.
ci-bot: snippet-harness: failed job `docs-snippets` - examples/go/stream_resume.go line 18 (context deadline exceeded). logs: https://ci.internal/snippets/5501
jen (eng-platform): quick fix: add context.WithTimeout to the go snippet and ensure filenames are kebab-case. i'll rerun harness after you push.
zoe (docs): pushed updates: go timeout added, filenames kebabified, migration table and a short costs note about long-lived streams consuming tokens.
li (eng-runtime): left two inline comments in the PR about KV cache wording and a small formatting nit.
ci-bot: snippet-harness: all checks passed on branch docs/stream-iter-refresh.
docs-bot: created issue #730 "e2e for resume-token reconnect" assigned to eng-runtime.
matt (eng-ml): lgtm.
jen (eng-platform): lgtm. merging in ~15m unless anyone objects. :tada:
